title: Super guide
text: We took a beautiful tour of the Alhambra guided by the excellent Gianluca. He showed us the most iconic spots of the great palace, allowing us to optimize our visit as best as possible. The explanations were clear and complete, revealing our guide's great experience and knowledge. Highly recommended to all Italians visiting Granada.
author: Francescapcm

title: Wonderful Alhambra
text: Visiting the entire Alhambra complex was a fantastic experience. The gardens, the flowers, the plants, the fountains and in particular the Nasrid palaces.
